text_block_list.text:
When I went to the trainer's office, Bamboo Memory
was doing squats.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: Extra training on your own? Admirable.
Doing extra training on your own is quite admirable.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!!
I'm honestly just completely hopeless...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...A rulebreaker just gave me the slip. To think I'd gas out from just that much..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll never let something like that happen again.
I've been retraining myself, partly as punishment...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because I've gotta protect
the discipline of this academy...!

It seems the fatigue from consecutive races is affecting her Disciplinary Committee activities.
We might need to reconsider her upcoming schedule.
